reviewedSafety.observation: Source/digest/staging checks precede the dispatch callback; durable reserve precedes write authorization; ownsDispatch false prevents another POST. Entering a possibly committed callback becomes uncertainty even if it throws. No automatic resend/deletion or filename attribution exists.

Specifications, intents and typed receipts bind exact UTF-8 account/Space/object/file/size. Native response account/Space extensions are rejected if conflicting. The callback records into the captured original journal before postflight account, consumer and cancellation checks; error exposes reference/count only.

Warm 201 immutable name/MIME/rootCID/inline metadata must match first info, then complete content size/SHA256 and second stable info. Cold resume proves only current stable metadata and original content, not historical 201 metadata. Cached/durable can advance and are reported from final info, not promoted to cloud custody.

Regular no-follow descriptors, bounded 1MiB streaming, 512MiB file ceiling, exact byte count/digest and metadata identity checks, private 0700/0600 staging, Apple protection before content, descriptor-relative identity-limited cleanup. Response is capped at65536 bytes for both advertised and chunked sizes; redirects/body-stream/auth replay are refused.
